title: A1 Swaara v1.0.8 - Enhanced Cloud, Community & Sync Experience
changelog:
- Community Charts Shelf: Real-time crowdsourced live leaderboard directly on your Home screen
- Automatic Background Sync: Automatically saves favorite songs and playlists to cloud without manual taps
- In-App Cloud Announcement Banner: Stay informed with official notifications and updates directly on Home
- Live Jam Room Status: Persistent active session pill across Home and Now Playing screens for seamless jam management
- Library Cloud Hub: Instant Cloud Sync, Live Jam, and Import Code buttons directly in your Library header
- 1-Tap Playlist Share: Share playlists with lightweight 6-character codes (SWxxxx) directly from playlist items and options menu
